items.stem:
Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Government measures include regulated markets, infrastructure such as storage, cooperative marketing and minimum support prices. Regulated markets were set up to protect farmers from the malpractices of traders. Alternative marketing channels let farmers sell directly to consumers and get higher prices. Some firms make contracts with farmers to buy their produce at pre-decided prices."
(i) Explain the term 'minimum support price', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: Farmers were often cheated in markets before regulation. (1)

items.answer: (i) The price at which the government buys certain crops from farmers to protect them against a fall in prices.
